findings.reason: the lead locked this scope deliberately and the deliverable, done-when and decision all state the narrower rule consistently, so only the title overstates it and no node's mechanism turns on the title.
findings.text: §5 is titled "Every section has a todo item", yet the locked `coverage-gap-scope` decision refuses only a gap a write introduces, so a plan already carrying an undeclared heading stays writable and may reach `done` with a section that has no todo item

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_require_heading_for_section_records` (`_store.py:1663`), `_write_state_locked` (`_store.py:1244`, calls the check at `:1416` on `source_text`), `_replace_plan_text` (`_store.py:1840`, entered by both `replace_plan_text` and `replace_plan_text_batch`), `_require_new_section_contracts` (`_store.py:1697`), `insert_section`, `write_state` (`_plan_html.py:1950`, renders `plan-section-declarations` at `:2020`), `reckon audit-doc`, and decision `coverage-gap-scope` all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the amended §5 done-when names a negative control for the new fifth test (the strict form) as it does for the other four, and §5's mechanism (a coverage check on both write paths, reading the declarations the write produces) can produce every assertion.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the census and gate results go to the plan's evidence record; no scratchpad, node-local or non-durable path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach code symbols or comments; the section ids the plan text uses are its own vocabulary.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §5's title asserts every section carries a todo item, but the `coverage-gap-scope` amendment it now rests on enforces only that a write adds no new gap, so grandfathered plans (109 of 214) may keep sections with no todo item.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §5 carries one deliverable, the heading/declaration coverage control (audit-doc reporting plus the write refusal).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the new decision `coverage-gap-scope` carries `data-sections="s5"`, a recognised decision attribute (`_plan_html.py:1247`), and `s5` exists, so the decision is bound to the section it changes.
